recipes.name: Fried Chicken inspired by Louie
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, broken down into 10 pieces
instructions: In a stock pot or large pot, begin by heating lard or shortening to 350° F. Don't exceed 350° or lard will smoke. - 4 cups lard or shortening
Using a sharp knife, break down the whole chicken into 10 standard fried chicken pieces. Set aside. - 1 whole chicken broken down into 10 pieces
Set aside 1 cup of flour in a separate bowl. - 3 cups flour

In a large bowl, whisk together remaining cups of flour, baking powder, garlic powder, cayenne, paprika, crushed cornflakes, and salt & pepper to taste. - 3 cups flour - 1 tsp baking powder - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 2 tsp cayenne - 1 tbsp paprika - 2 cups cornflakes crushed - Salt & pepper to taste
In another bowl, whisk together eggs and lemon juice. - 5 eggs - 1 juice of lemon
Dip chicken pieces into the plain flour, then in egg mixture, then in seasoned flour. Repeat until all chicken pieces are coated. - For the Chicken - For the Breading
Once the lard reaches 350° F, gently lower the chicken pieces in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the pieces.
Fry for 7-10 minutes, flipping as necessary using metal tongs, until evenly brown.
Place on a wire cooling rack in baking tray and keep warm in the oven until all the chicken is cooked. Ensure the white meat is heated to 155° F internally and the dark meat to 170° F.
